title: Layered Rain
caption: A reflective, immersive rainy lo-fi instrumental track with modern chillhop production, led by expressive close-mic felt piano and a memorable melodic riff. It opens with felt piano, then soft brushed drums and a round, gentle bass enter beneath warm Rhodes playing soft, consonant minor chords that stay in key. A delicate celesta answers the piano far in the background, adding a distinct layered shimmer. The mix is clean but warm, with light vinyl crackle, subtle tape saturation and an airy reverb, evoking a lamplit room beside a rain-covered window. It gradually adds gentle layers while keeping the emotional melody clear and ends with a soft fade-out as the piano returns to the opening riff.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano]
[Main Theme - piano and Rhodes]
[Layered Theme - piano and celesta]
[Outro - piano, music fades out]
